title: Minimum Possible Maximum Waiting Time
summary: Car 0 becomes eligible at 0; car i becomes eligible when car i-1 STARTS service. Choose either dispenser with enough remaining fuel, even if the other becomes free sooner. No dispenser-index tie-break exists. Assignment cannot change. Start immediately when the chosen dispenser is free; service lasts demand[i] seconds and consumes that fuel at its start. If neither dispenser has enough fuel, stop without skipping the car. Maximize the served prefix length FIRST, then minimize the largest eligibility-to-start wait; return -1 if none served.
officialConstraints: 1..50 cars; each demand 1..20; exactly two fuel capacities, each 1..50.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
clarification: Accounting: eligible[0]=0; eligible[i]=start[i-1]; start[i]=max(eligible[i],freeAt[chosen]); wait[i]=start[i]-eligible[i]. Fuel is never replenished. A free but insufficient dispenser cannot serve the car.
constraintsReportedBySource: 1..50 cars; each demand 1..20; exactly two fuel capacities, each 1..50.
